name: gradient-young-passion

frames.best_why: The complete gradient reads cleanly from coral at the left to magenta at the right.

tagline: A coral-to-magenta wash sweeps left to right across a rounded panel.
summary: A decorative horizontal gradient block that starts in warm coral pink and deepens to berry magenta, with soft rounded corners and no content of its own.
appearance: A wide rectangular band with softly rounded corners, filled by a left-to-right gradient that begins in coral pink and deepens to berry magenta at the right edge. Even black margins surround it.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The colour stops are fixed, though extra classes or inline styles can repaint and resize it.
use_when: A warm coral-to-berry wash is needed behind a hero, card or banner.
avoid_when: It is flat colour with no motion, and white text on the magenta end may lose contrast.
customise: The gradient stops sit in the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight_why: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.

a11y.note: Purely decorative: no text, controls or focus, so it conveys no information on its own.

polish_why: Smooth, cleanly rounded gradient; it is still just a stock two-colour wash.
